goal: 完成开场演讲并从容回应提问

n1.speaker: 评委 Professor Reed
n1.line: Welcome to the opening ceremony. Never have I seen such a full auditorium on a winter evening.
n1.lineCn: 欢迎来到开幕典礼。我从未在冬日的傍晚见过这么满的礼堂。

grammar.name: 否定词句首部分倒装
grammar.note: Never 置于句首,助动词 have 提到主语 I 前,构成部分倒装,语气强烈正式。

options.text: Thank you, Professor. Never have I felt more honoured than I do standing here today.
options.textCn: 谢谢教授。站在这里,我从未感到如此荣幸。
options.feedback: 用倒装句回应倒装句,开场漂亮。

options.text: Thank you. I hope the audience will enjoy my speech, whatever its quality may be.
options.textCn: 谢谢。希望听众喜欢我的演讲,无论它质量如何。

options.text: The hall is full, but so is my nervousness. I fear I may forget my lines.
options.textCn: 礼堂是满的,我的紧张也是。我怕我会忘词。

n2.speaker: 评委 Professor Reed
n2.line: A confident opening, indeed. Not only is this ceremony a test of your speech, but it is also a celebration of hard work.
n2.lineCn: 确实是个自信的开场。这场典礼不仅是对你演讲的考验,也是对努力的庆祝。

grammar.name: Not only...but also 倒装
grammar.note: Not only 置于句首时,be 动词 is 提前形成部分倒装,与 but also 呼应,表递进。

options.text: Not only have I prepared for weeks, but I have also practised before a mirror every evening.
options.textCn: 我不仅准备了好几周,还每晚对着镜子练习。
options.feedback: 如实汇报准备情况,印象良好。

options.text: I prepared, but not very thoroughly. I hope the audience will be forgiving.
options.textCn: 我准备了,但不太充分。希望听众宽容。

options.text: Speaking of celebration, may I ask when the results will be announced?
options.textCn: 说到庆祝,我能问问结果什么时候公布吗?

n3.speaker: 评委 Professor Reed
n3.line: Do not be so hard on yourself. Only when you trust your preparation can you speak with genuine ease.
n3.lineCn: 别对自己太苛刻。只有当你信任自己的准备,才能真正从容地演讲。

grammar.name: Only when 倒装
grammar.note: Only when 引导状语从句置于句首,主句部分倒装,can 提到主语 you 前。

options.text: You are right. Only by practising repeatedly can I truly relax on stage.
options.textCn: 您说得对。只有反复练习,我才能在台上真正放松。

options.text: I trust my notes more than myself. Hardly have I delivered a speech without reading them.
options.textCn: 我更信任讲稿而非自己。我几乎没有不读稿讲过话。
options.feedback: 坦诚但依赖讲稿,教授提醒。

options.text: To be frank, I am here mainly because my teacher forced me to apply.
options.textCn: 坦白说,我来主要是老师逼我报名的。

n4.speaker: 评委 Professor Reed
n4.line: Then step onto the stage. Rarely do we give such young speakers a full hour, so make every minute count.
n4.lineCn: 那么上台吧。我们很少给这么年轻的演讲者整整一小时,所以请让每一分钟都有价值。

grammar.name: Rarely 句首倒装
grammar.note: Rarely 是半否定副词,置于句首时助动词 do 提前,构成部分倒装。

options.text: I will. Seldom have I had such a precious opportunity, and I will not waste it.
options.textCn: 我会的。我极少有这样的宝贵机会,绝不会浪费。

options.text: An hour is short. Only when the clock starts will I feel the real pressure.
options.textCn: 一小时很短。只有计时开始,我才会感到真正的压力。

options.text: Could you shorten my time? The shorter the speech, the safer I feel.
options.textCn: 能缩短我的时间吗?演讲越短,我越有安全感。
options.feedback: 怯场讨价还价,评委不满。

n4b.speaker: 评委 Professor Reed
n4b.line: Then compose yourself. Seldom is a speaker judged by the first sentence alone, but first impressions still count.
n4b.lineCn: 那么镇定下来。演讲者很少仅凭第一句就被评判,但第一印象仍然重要。

grammar.name: Seldom 句首倒装
grammar.note: Seldom 置句首,系动词 is 提前形成部分倒装,表示"很少发生"。

options.text: Then I will open with a striking statistic. Only when the audience leans in will my story begin.
options.textCn: 那我就以一个醒目的数据开场。只有当听众倾身时,我的故事才会开始。
options.feedback: 开场设计巧妙,评委赞许。

options.text: I will open with a joke. Never has a joke failed to warm up a crowd.
options.textCn: 我打算用笑话开场。笑话从未没能让观众热场。

options.text: I will open with an apology for my poor English. So weak is my grammar that I fear ridicule.
options.textCn: 我打算先为蹩脚的英语道歉。我的语法弱到担心被嘲笑。

n5.speaker: 评委 Professor Reed
n5.line: That question belongs in the Q&A session. Not until your speech ends can you take questions, so focus first.
n5.lineCn: 那个问题属于问答环节。直到演讲结束你才能回答问题,所以先专注演讲。

grammar.name: Not until 倒装
grammar.note: Not until 引导时间状语置于句首,主句部分倒装,can 提到主语 you 前。

options.text: Understood. Not until my speech is over will I think about anything else.
options.textCn: 明白了。直到演讲结束,我才会考虑其他任何事。

options.text: I cannot focus with so many eyes on me. So nervous am I that my hands are shaking.
options.textCn: 这么多双眼睛看着我,我无法专注。我紧张到双手发抖。

options.text: Rules are rules, but never have I followed them blindly. I will answer questions anyway.
options.textCn: 规矩是规矩,但我从不盲从。反正我要回答问题。
options.feedback: 不守规矩,评委严肃警告。

n6.speaker: 评委 Professor Reed
n6.line: Very well. The stage is yours. Now comes the moment we have all been waiting for.
n6.lineCn: 很好。舞台交给你。现在,我们等待已久的时刻到来了。

grammar.name: 完全倒装 Now comes
grammar.note: 地点/时间副词 now 置于句首,谓语 comes 提到主语前,构成完全倒装,用于正式宣告。

options.text: Thank you. Here begins my speech on the future of artificial intelligence.
options.textCn: 谢谢。我的演讲《人工智能的未来》从这里开始。
options.feedback: 开场干脆利落,观众鼓掌。

options.text: Thank you. Before I start, could you repeat the time limit once more?
options.textCn: 谢谢。开始前,您能再重复一遍时限吗?

options.text: I am not ready. Only tomorrow would I feel prepared enough to speak.
options.textCn: 我没准备好。只有明天我才会觉得自己足够有准备。

n7.speaker: 评委 Professor Reed
n7.line: (After your speech) Splendid delivery! The audience is now ready for questions. Only two questions remain on the list.
n7.lineCn: (演讲后)精彩的表达!观众现在准备提问了。名单上只剩下两个问题。

grammar.name: Only+名词短语倒装
grammar.note: Only two questions 置于句首并非倒装,此处强调剩余数量,注意 Only 后接从句才倒装。

options.text: I would be glad to answer any question. Nothing have I prepared more eagerly for than this session.
options.textCn: 我很乐意回答任何问题。没有比这个环节我更热切准备的。

options.text: So relieved am I that the speech is over that I would rather skip the questions.
options.textCn: 演讲结束我如释重负,真想跳过提问。

options.text: Questions make me uneasy. Never have I handled unexpected questions well.
options.textCn: 提问让我不安。我从未妥善处理过突发提问。

n7b.speaker: 评委 Professor Reed
n7b.line: Then let the questions begin. Hardly has a speech been finished when the real test starts.
n7b.lineCn: 那么提问开始。演讲一结束,真正的考验就开始。

grammar.name: Hardly...when 倒装
grammar.note: Hardly 置于句首,助动词 has 提前,与 when 连用,表示"一……就……"。

options.text: I understand. Hardly had I finished speaking when my heart began racing.
options.textCn: 我明白。我一讲完,心就开始怦怦跳。

options.text: Bring on the questions! Not until I answer the last one will I allow myself to relax.
options.textCn: 放马过来!直到回答完最后一个问题,我才会让自己放松。

options.text: I feel faint. Only if you promise gentle questions will I continue.
options.textCn: 我头昏。只有您保证问题温和,我才继续。

n8.speaker: 评委 Professor Reed
n8.line: Here is the first question: not only does your proposal promise efficiency, but it also threatens jobs. How do you respond?
n8.lineCn: 这是第一个问题:你的方案不仅承诺效率,也威胁就业。你如何回应?

grammar.name: Not only 倒装(提问)
grammar.note: not only 置于分句首,助动词 does 提前,构成部分倒装,提问更正式有力。

options.text: Fair question. Not only does automation create new roles, but it also frees people for creative work.
options.textCn: 问得好。自动化不仅创造新岗位,还把人们解放出来从事创造性工作。
options.feedback: 回应专业有力,观众信服。

options.text: I have not considered that side of the issue, to be honest.
options.textCn: 老实说,我没考虑过问题的这一面。
options.feedback: 诚实但显不足,评委追问。

options.text: Job losses are not my concern. Only the technical side interests me.
options.textCn: 失业不是我的事。只有技术层面让我感兴趣。
options.feedback: 回避社会责任,印象大打折扣。

n9.speaker: 评委 Professor Reed
n9.line: A thoughtful answer. Here comes the final question, from the dean of our faculty.
n9.lineCn: 深思熟虑的回答。最后一个问题来了,来自我们学院院长。

grammar.name: 完全倒装 Here comes
grammar.note: 副词 here 置句首,动词 comes 完全倒装,正式场合宣告某人/事到来。

options.text: I am listening. Never have I underestimated a question from the dean.
options.textCn: 我在听。我从未低估过院长的提问。

options.text: Not again! Only if the question is easy will I attempt an answer.
options.textCn: 又来!只有问题简单我才试着回答。
options.feedback: 轻慢态度,院长再问一遍。

options.text: Whatever the question is, I am confident I can respond with grace.
options.textCn: 无论什么问题,我都有信心优雅回应。

success.speaker: 评委 Professor Reed
success.line: A most impressive performance. Never have I seen a young speaker handle tough questions with such grace. Well done!
success.lineCn: 非常精彩的表演。我从未见过年轻演讲者如此优雅地应对刁钻问题。干得漂亮!

fail1.speaker: 评委 Professor Reed
fail1.line: I am sorry to hear that. Only when you value your audience will your words truly matter.
fail1.lineCn: 听到这些我很遗憾。只有当你重视听众,你的话语才真正有分量。

fail2.speaker: 评委 Professor Reed
fail2.line: Preparation is the mother of confidence. Never step onto a stage half-prepared again.
fail2.lineCn: 准备是自信之母。永远不要再半吊子地走上舞台。
